profile.name: Zahner设备搜索器
profile.description: 用于发现和选择Zahner仪器串口接口的软件组件（非物理设备）。它通过USB VID/PID与*IDN?查询识别已连接的Zahner设备，并返回命令口、数据口及相关串口信息，便于电化学仪器接入、通信配置和校准辅助。
profile.description_en: A software component for discovering and selecting serial interfaces of Zahner instruments; it is not a physical device. It identifies connected Zahner devices using USB VID/PID information and *IDN? queries, then returns command, data, and related serial-port information to support instrument connection, communication setup, and calibration assistance.

A software component for discovering and selecting serial interfaces of Zahner instruments; it is not a physical device. It identifies connected Zahner devices using USB VID/PID information and *IDN? queries, then returns command, data, and related serial-port information to support instrument connection, communication setup, and calibration assistance.
